name: Wf4Ever Building Blocks
abstract:
Building blocks for the Wf4Ever ontologies suite (wfdesc, wfprov, ro, wf4ever) enabling
workflow description, provenance tracking, research object aggregation, and specialized artifact types.
description:
This repository contains four separate building blocks for the **Wf4Ever ontologies**:

- **wfdesc**: Workflow Description Ontology for describing workflow structure (prospective provenance)
- **wfprov**: Workflow Provenance Ontology for tracking execution traces (retrospective provenance)
- **ro**: Research Object Ontology for packaging and aggregating research artifacts
- **wf4ever**: Extension ontology providing specialized artifact types (File, Dataset, Document, Image) and process types (WebServiceProcess, WorkflowResearchObject)

All examples are based on real CWL (Common Workflow Language) provenance data from
scientific workflow executions.

bblocks.name: ro:Resource
bblocks.abstract: A resource that can be aggregated in a Research Object. Resources represent any artifact that contributes to the research outcome, such as data files, workflows, documentation, or external references.

bblocks.name: ro:Folder
bblocks.abstract: A folder that organizes resources within a Research Object. Folders provide hierarchical structure, similar to filesystem directories, allowing logical grouping of related resources.

bblocks.name: ro:SemanticAnnotation
bblocks.abstract: A semantic annotation is a specialization of ao:Annotation which requires that the annotation body points to an RDF Graph containing semantic information about the annotated resource.

bblocks.name: Research Object Ontology (ro)
bblocks.abstract: The Research Object ontology (ro) provides concepts for bundling and aggregating research artifacts, describing folder structures and annotations.

bblocks.name: roevo:VersionableResource
bblocks.abstract: A resource within an RO that can be versioned with change specifications.

bblocks.name: roterms:Answer
bblocks.abstract: Represents an answer to a question in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:BugReport
bblocks.abstract: Represents a bug report in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Comment
bblocks.abstract: Represents a comment in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Commit
bblocks.abstract: Represents a version control commit in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:DataRequest
bblocks.abstract: Represents a data request in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:DataResponse
bblocks.abstract: Represents a response to a data request in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Discussion
bblocks.abstract: Represents a discussion thread in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:FeatureRequest
bblocks.abstract: Represents a feature request in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Issue
bblocks.abstract: Represents an issue in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Manuscript
bblocks.abstract: Represents a manuscript in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Note
bblocks.abstract: A note or free-text comment relevant to the research object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Poster
bblocks.abstract: Represents a scientific poster in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Presentation
bblocks.abstract: Represents a presentation in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:ProspectivePlan
bblocks.abstract: A prospective plan outlining intended tasks or steps.

bblocks.name: roterms:PullRequest
bblocks.abstract: Represents a pull request in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:QualityAnnotation
bblocks.abstract: Quality annotation associated with a Research Object or its components.

bblocks.name: roterms:Question
bblocks.abstract: Represents a question in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Rating
bblocks.abstract: Represents a rating or score assigned to a Research Object or its components.

bblocks.name: roterms:Report
bblocks.abstract: Represents a report in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Review
bblocks.abstract: Represents a review or examination associated with a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Script
bblocks.abstract: Represents a script or executable code in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Software
bblocks.abstract: Software referenced or used within the research object.

bblocks.name: roterms:SourceCode
bblocks.abstract: Represents source code in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Task
bblocks.abstract: Represents a task or action to be performed in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:WebService
bblocks.abstract: A web service referenced or used by the research object.

bblocks.name: wf4ever:Dataset
bblocks.abstract: A dataset artifact - a collection of data values or files representing a scientific dataset.

bblocks.name: wf4ever:Document
bblocks.abstract: A document artifact - textual or formatted content such as PDF, HTML, or text files.

bblocks.name: wf4ever:File
bblocks.abstract: A file artifact - a specialization of wfdesc:Artifact representing a file-based data entity used or produced by workflow execution.

bblocks.name: wf4ever:Image
bblocks.abstract: An image artifact - visual representation such as PNG, JPEG, or raster geospatial imagery.

bblocks.name: wf4ever:WebServiceProcess
bblocks.abstract: A web service process - a process description whose enactment involves making a web service call.

bblocks.name: Workflow Description Ontology (wfdesc)
bblocks.abstract: The Workflow Description ontology (wfdesc) describes the structure of workflows, including processes, inputs, outputs, and data flow.

bblocks.name: wfdesc:Artifact
bblocks.abstract: An artifact representing a data value, file, or resource that can be used as input or generated as output by workflow processes. Artifacts provide concrete data representations for parameter binding.

bblocks.name: wfdesc:WorkflowInstance
bblocks.abstract: A specialized workflow description that includes all concrete data, parameters, and settings required to execute a specific workflow run. It bridges the gap between abstract workflow descriptions and concrete workflow executions.

bblocks.name: roevo:Change
bblocks.abstract: Represents a change in the context of Research Object evolution.

bblocks.name: roevo:ChangeSpecification
bblocks.abstract: A specification of changes (additions, removals, modifications) applied between versions.

bblocks.name: roterms:DataAnalysis
bblocks.abstract: Represents a data analysis in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:DataCollection
bblocks.abstract: Represents a data collection in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:DataTransformation
bblocks.abstract: Represents a data transformation in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:DataVisualization
bblocks.abstract: Represents a data visualization in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:ExperimentalDesign
bblocks.abstract: An experimental design describing methodology, variables, and sample size.

bblocks.name: roterms:ScientificMethod
bblocks.abstract: A description of the scientific method or approach used.

bblocks.name: ro:AggregatedAnnotation
bblocks.abstract: An annotation about resources within a Research Object. Annotations provide additional metadata, provenance information, or contextual details about aggregated resources, stored as part of the Research Object itself.

bblocks.name: ro:Manifest
bblocks.abstract: A manifest that describes the structure and contents of a Research Object. The manifest provides metadata about the Research Object, its aggregated resources, annotations, and organizational structure.

bblocks.name: ro:FolderEntry
bblocks.abstract: An entry within a folder that associates a name with a resource. FolderEntries provide the mapping between folder paths and actual resources, similar to filesystem directory entries.

bblocks.name: wfdesc:Parameter
bblocks.abstract: A parameter (input or output) of a workflow process. This is the base class for Input, Output, and Configuration.

bblocks.name: roevo:Addition
bblocks.abstract: Represents the addition of a resource in the context of Research Object evolution.

bblocks.name: roevo:Modification
bblocks.abstract: Represents the modification of a resource in the context of Research Object evolution.

bblocks.name: roevo:Removal
bblocks.abstract: Represents the removal of a resource in the context of Research Object evolution.

bblocks.name: ro:ResearchObject
bblocks.abstract: A Research Object that bundles resources, data, methods, and contextual information. It provides a structured way to package research outputs with their provenance, making them portable, shareable, and preservable.

bblocks.name: roterms:Parameter
bblocks.abstract: Represents a parameter in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: wfdesc:Input
bblocks.abstract: An input parameter to a workflow process. Inputs receive data from external sources or from outputs of other processes via DataLinks.

bblocks.name: wfdesc:Output
bblocks.abstract: An output parameter from a workflow process. Outputs produce data that can be consumed by inputs of other processes or as final workflow results.

bblocks.name: Research Object Evolution Ontology (roevo)
bblocks.abstract: The Research Object Evolution ontology (roevo) extends ro to capture lifecycle, versioning, and evolution of research objects using PROV-O.

bblocks.name: Research Object Terms (roterms)
bblocks.abstract: The Research Object Terms vocabulary defines classes and properties for annotations on Research Objects and their resources.

bblocks.name: wfprov:Artifact
bblocks.abstract: A data entity that was used as input or generated as output during a workflow execution. Artifacts are the data products consumed or produced by process runs.

bblocks.name: wfprov:WorkflowEngine
bblocks.abstract: A software agent that executes workflows. The WorkflowEngine is responsible for enacting workflow and process executions, managing the execution environment and resources.

bblocks.name: Workflow Provenance Ontology (wfprov)
bblocks.abstract: The Workflow Provenance ontology (wfprov) extends PROV-O to describe workflow execution traces, linking workflow runs to their descriptions.

bblocks.name: roterms:Input
bblocks.abstract: Represents an input in the context of a Research Object workflow or process.

bblocks.name: roterms:OptionalInput
bblocks.abstract: Represents an optional input parameter for a workflow in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Output
bblocks.abstract: Represents an output in the context of a Research Object workflow or process.

bblocks.name: wfdesc:DataLink
bblocks.abstract: A connection between processes in a workflow, linking an output of one process to an input of another process. DataLinks define the data flow in a workflow.

bblocks.name: wfdesc:Process
bblocks.abstract: A computational process or task in a workflow. Processes have inputs, outputs, and perform computations. This is the base class for atomic processes and composite Workflows.

bblocks.name: roevo:ArchivedRO
bblocks.abstract: A Research Object that has been archived and is immutable, with associated archival metadata.

bblocks.name: roevo:LiveRO
bblocks.abstract: A live Research Object that is mutable and can evolve over time before being snapshotted or archived.

bblocks.name: roevo:SnapshotRO
bblocks.abstract: An immutable snapshot of a Research Object at a given time.

bblocks.name: roterms:Conclusion
bblocks.abstract: A conclusion drawn from evidence within the research object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Hypothesis
bblocks.abstract: A hypothesis formulated within a research object, to be supported or refuted by evidence.

bblocks.name: roterms:Paper
bblocks.abstract: Represents a scientific paper in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:ResearchQuestion
bblocks.abstract: Represents a research question in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Result
bblocks.abstract: Represents a result or outcome in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:Sketch
bblocks.abstract: A sketch or diagram relevant to the research object.

bblocks.name: roterms:WorkflowValue
bblocks.abstract: Represents a value associated with a workflow parameter in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: Wf4Ever Extension Ontology
bblocks.abstract: The wf4ever ontology extends ro, wfdesc and wfprov with specialized artifact and process types commonly used in workflow research objects.

bblocks.name: wfdesc:Workflow
bblocks.abstract: A composite process that contains sub-processes connected by data links. Workflows are directed graphs where nodes are processes and edges are data flow connections.

bblocks.name: wfprov:ProcessRun
bblocks.abstract: An execution instance of a process. A ProcessRun represents the actual execution of a process described by wfdesc:Process, tracking what happened during that execution including inputs used, outputs generated, and timing information.

bblocks.name: wf4ever:WorkflowResearchObject
bblocks.abstract: A research object that aggregates at least one workflow description, along with associated resources and provenance.

bblocks.name: wfprov:WorkflowRun
bblocks.abstract: An execution instance of a workflow. A WorkflowRun is a special type of ProcessRun that represents the execution of a complete workflow (wfdesc:Workflow), containing multiple ProcessRuns for its sub-processes.

bblocks.name: roterms:ExampleRun
bblocks.abstract: Represents an example run of a workflow in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:ProspectiveRun
bblocks.abstract: Represents a prospective run of a workflow in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: roterms:ResultGenerationRun
bblocks.abstract: Represents a workflow run that generates research results in the context of a Research Object.

bblocks.name: Complete Workflow Provenance Trace
bblocks.abstract: Master profile combining Research Object, Workflow Description, and Workflow Execution Provenance

sources.title: CWLProv - Provenance profiles for Common Workflow Language

bblocks.description:
## Description

This master profile combines all elements of the Wf4Ever ontology suite to represent a complete workflow provenance trace:

- **Research Object (RO)**: Container aggregating all workflow-related resources
- **Workflow Description (WFDESC)**: Prospective provenance - the workflow structure and specification
- **Workflow Execution (WFPROV)**: Retrospective provenance - the actual execution trace

This building block demonstrates the full integration of:
1. Workflow structure (inputs, outputs, steps)
2. Execution trace (runs, artifacts, agents)
3. Research object packaging (aggregation, annotations, manifest)

## Purpose

This profile serves multiple purposes:
- **Validation**: End-to-end test of the complete Wf4Ever model
- **Documentation**: Demonstrates how all pieces fit together
- **Interoperability**: Shows mapping to PROV-O and other standards
- **Real-world example**: Based on actual CWLProv data from scientific workflows

## Use Cases

1. **Scientific Workflow Archival**: Package complete workflow execution for reproducibility
2. **Provenance Tracking**: Track data lineage from input to output through workflow steps
3. **Workflow Sharing**: Share not just the workflow definition, but execution traces and results
4. **Compliance**: Meet FAIR data principles with complete provenance metadata

## Structure

A complete provenance trace contains:

```
Research Object
├── Manifest (describes RO)
├── Workflow (wfdesc:Workflow)
│   ├── Inputs (wfdesc:Input)
│   ├── Outputs (wfdesc:Output)
│   └── Processes (wfdesc:Process)
├── WorkflowRun (wfprov:WorkflowRun)
│   ├── Used (input artifacts)
│   ├── Generated (output artifacts)
│   ├── wasAssociatedWith (agents/engines)
│   └── ProcessRuns (sub-executions)
└── Annotations (metadata, attributions)
```

## Mapping to Standards

- **PROV-O**: WorkflowRun → prov:Activity, Artifacts → prov:Entity
- **DCAT**: Research Object → dcat:Dataset
- **OGC API Processes**: Workflow → Process description
- **ORE**: Research Object uses ORE aggregation model
